task_failure_diagnosis.late_gate_failure_semantics: All 103 late-gate failures are caused by existing source spill; no observed added dose from action end through physical7s.
task_failure_diagnosis.interpretation: The predefined feasibility-first choice reduces spill while retaining severe dose error; no success or optimality claim.

next_route.status_at_report_preparation: CPU preparation only; no direct-route liquid test result included

limitations: CEM tunes speed/stop feedback on a fixed kinematic robot path, not neural or joint-torque learning.
The baseline is the initial V3 five-second controller; historical V2 accuracy is not a paired baseline here.
All failures remain in raw action/post logs and every aggregate; post observation cannot rescue a five-second miss.
Volumes are privileged simulation particle truth, quantum 0.042875mL, not hardware/vision accuracy.
Joint acceleration uses a declared simulation envelope; friction grasp, torque feasibility and full collision safety are not established by kinematic FK alone.
The public protocol_summary is an excerpt without private absolute paths. Its JSON hash is not the original canonical protocol_id.

Robot NPZ banks describe joint/path geometry, never recorded liquid states. Rebuilt cache bytes depend on the SDK, bank and NumPy and need not match the original SHA. A fresh explicit SHA pin, engineering pilot and protocol are required; original local logs cannot be resumed.
No new GUI default is deployed. Candidate/recommended filenames are frozen research roles, not successful-task certificates.
Joint derivatives are audited at240Hz; FK/TCP are audited at60Hz. Narrow initial position/viscosity randomization and three holdout seeds do not establish hardware or broad task generalization.
